name: orbit
js: (() => { window.__cs = { n: 0, max: 0, sum: 0 }; if (!CLOUDS.__cs) { const d0 = CLOUDS.draw; CLOUDS.draw = function (r, cam) { if (cam === FLIGHT_PROBE.camera()) { const q = new THREE.Quaternion(); cam.matrixWorld.decompose(new THREE.Vector3(), q, new THREE.Vector3()); const a = 2 * Math.acos(Math.min(1, Math.abs(q.dot(cam.quaternion)))) * 180 / Math.PI; __cs.n++; __cs.max = Math.max(__cs.max, a); __cs.sum += a; } return d0.apply(this, arguments); }; CLOUDS.__cs = 1; } return 1; })()
report: JSON.stringify({ cloudCamLagDeg: { frames: __cs.n, max: +__cs.max.toFixed(3), mean: +(__cs.sum / Math.max(1, __cs.n)).toFixed(3) } })
